normalizer.scope: On the custom domain and HTML only, it first removes the established analytics transport injection. It then matches only a Cloudflare email-protection href with the exact /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection# prefix and a hexadecimal payload, XOR-decodes that payload into a mailto href, and removes the exact Cloudflare decoder tag only if at least one protected href was transformed. The final SHA equality assertion still applies to the complete normalized response.
normalizer.overbreadth: No broad HTML region, arbitrary href, or hash mismatch is ignored. The normalizer does not apply at the immutable origin, to JavaScript, or to pages without a matching protected href.

protectedMailtoEvidence.chamberIndependentCheck: PASS: one decoder tag and 28 protected hrefs were present; exact XOR normalization removed that tag and produced a byte-for-byte match to the immutable chamber response.

limitations: This reviews the verifier repair and its evidence only; it does not replace browser journey verification.
